dcea6b6d: If DV exists, go to M^DIE17. If DV contains 'V', go to ^DIE3. If DV does not contain 'S', go to P. If there is executable code at ^DD(DP,DIFLD,12.1), execute it. Set % to the second piece of the DU string delimited by ';_X_:'. If % is not null, execute DIC("S") if it exists. If the result is true, write out '% ' unless DB(DQ) is defined, and then go to V.

a517cd35: Loop through each piece of DU delimited by ';'. Set Y to the piece and DG to the position of ':_X' within Y. If DG is non-zero, execute DIC("S") if it exists. If the result is true, quit the loop. If Y is null, go to X.
1f44fade: If DB(DQ) is not defined, write out the portion of YS starting from position DG. Set X to the portion of YS before the first ':'.

7a19260e: If DV contains 'P', set DIC to the unscrambled version of DU, and set DIC(0) based on whether DB(DQ) is defined and whether DV contains '''. If DIC(0) contains 'L', set DLAYGO to the second piece of the 'P' node in DV. If DV does not contain '*', call ^DIC. Set X to the value of Y, and set DIC back to DIE. If X is negative, go to X.
5b258b7e: If DV does not contain 'N', call D. If the length of the portion of X after the decimal point is greater than 24, kill X and go to Z.

1ce34a5f: If the second piece of the DV string delimited by ',' is non-zero, and X contains '.', and the 5th piece of DQ(DQ) delimited by U does not start with '$', then process X to remove leading and trailing zeroes and convert to a canonical number format if possible.

3f775737: Kill DIC("S") and DLAYGO. If X exists and is not null, set DG(DW) to X. If DV contains 'd', set ^DISV(DUZ,"DIE",DLB) to X. Then go to A.
